# Vendor assets

These must be downloaded separately and are not committed to git.

## PDF.js
Download the pre-built release from https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases
Extract `pdfjs-*-dist.zip` and copy its contents into `pdfjs/`:
- `pdfjs/pdf.mjs`
- `pdfjs/pdf.worker.mjs`

## foliate-js
Clone or download from https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js
Copy the library files into `foliate-js/`:
- `foliate-js/view.js`
- `foliate-js/reader.js`
- (and any other JS files it needs)

## Vazirmatn
Download from https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/releases
Copy into `vazirmatn/`:
- `vazirmatn/Vazirmatn-Regular.woff2`
- `vazirmatn/Vazirmatn-Bold.woff2`
